product_updates.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked
product_updates.content: Anthropic’s S-1 shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers now use both the Claude Platform and a first-party app, a cross-selling playbook reminiscent of Amazon that’s making enterprise customers stickier.

product_updates.title: SpaceX locks in $40B GPU financing deal with Apollo
product_updates.content: The financing gives SpaceX another way to fund its rapidly expanding AI ambitions without relying solely on traditional debt markets.

product_updates.title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut
product_updates.content: Anthropic has officially filed for an IPO, revealing soaring revenue, mounting losses, major enterprise adoption, and an unusual governance structure designed to preserve founder control and its AI safety mission.
